what: The wave (hill) shape at section boundaries morphs into a different wave as you scroll — not tied directly to the scroll value, each frame it closes 8% of the remaining distance so the ground follows with a slow sway. 0 when the boundary enters the bottom of the screen, 1 when it reaches the top
ease: none (tied to scroll · eases .08 closer each frame)

options.[data-fx-part=path]: path to morph — start shape is d, end shape is data-to
options.lerp: Per-frame approach ratio, default .08 (1 ties it directly to scroll)
options.from: With half, only the 0.5→1 progress range is used (original half boundary)
